paragraphs: A pigeon skull is mostly eye socket. The orbits are so large that they meet in the middle, separated by a paper thin wall of bone, which is why the brain sits behind them rather than between them and why birds move their heads instead of their eyes.
The model is very light at 6,250 polygons and 6,166 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so it runs in interactive material. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits biology and veterinary education, museum and exhibition work, scientific illustration, comparative anatomy reference and editorial material. On sale since 2025.

A fully automatic shotgun is a strange weapon: enormous close range effect, almost no recoil thanks to a very slow action, and a rate of fire that empties a drum faster than most people expect. It has appeared in far more games than armies.
The model is light at 30,907 polygons and 31,707 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits game weapons, film and television props, concept art, simulation, defence illustration and editorial work. On sale since 2017.

Once containers are stacked, getting people between the levels becomes the design problem. A module that is half stair and half container solves it by being part of the stack rather than bolted to the outside of it.
The model holds 508,565 polygons and 502,066 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in grey. It is built to CheckMate specification.

At $49 it suits modular construction and site visualisation, architectural presentation, industrial and logistics scenes, film backgrounds, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The office phone booth exists because open plan removed every room and then discovered people still need to talk. It is a piece of furniture pretending to be architecture, and it is bought by the dozen wherever the walls were taken out.
The model is light at 29,734 polygons and 15,223 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits office and interior visualisation, furniture marketing, workplace presentation, architectural scenes, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2024.

A cruise missile is an aeroplane that only flies once. Wings deploy after launch, a small turbofan takes over, and it navigates by comparing the ground beneath it to a map it was given before it left, low enough that radar struggles to separate it from terrain.
The model is very light at 10,352 polygons and 10,340 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in the flight configuration. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits defence visualisation, news and documentary graphics, simulation, animation sequences, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

A full ballistic face mask is one of the most immediately recognisable pieces of modern protective equipment, largely because it looks like something from fiction. The respirator underneath is the functional part; the shape above it is what everyone remembers.
The model holds 56,013 polygons and 56,350 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, in black, and carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits character and costume work, game assets, film and television props, concept art, airsoft and equipment imagery, and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

A slab digital piano is defined by what it leaves out. No cabinet, no lid, no stand: just the keyboard and the action, because the whole point is that it fits in a flat, gets carried to a gig, and weighs what one person can lift.
The model holds 122,274 polygons and 65,248 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits musical instrument marketing, e-commerce and retail imagery, studio and interior scenes, advertising, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

The battery is the car now. Taking one apart shows the hierarchy that decides everything about an electric vehicle: cells inside modules, modules inside a pack, cooling running between them, and a structure that is also part of the chassis.

The model holds 476,968 polygons and 243,447 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in the disassembled state. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and an opened build is offered separately.
At $49 it suits automotive engineering visualisation, technical and training material, manufacturing and recycling presentation, education and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

An automatic satellite dish finds its own bird. It sweeps, locks and then holds position while the vehicle it is mounted on moves, which is the difference between television in a parked caravan and television on the road.
The model is light at 31,236 polygons and 32,656 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits product and equipment visualisation, vehicle and caravan scenes, broadcast and telecoms presentation, e-commerce imagery, film props and game environments. On sale since 2022.

The flat dolly is the least designed object in any warehouse and one of the most used. Four castors, a deck and no handle, because the load is what you push and the cart is only there to stop it dragging.
The model holds 347,540 polygons and 342,766 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits warehouse and logistics visualisation, retail and industrial interiors, equipment marketing, film set dressing, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The cordless stick vacuum moved the motor into the handle, which changed the whole balance of the object: it is held rather than dragged, and everything about the weight distribution follows from being carried at arm's length up a staircase.
The model is light at 38,732 polygons and 42,854 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied with the screw tool. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits product and appliance visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, interior scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

A samovar keeps water hot rather than boiling it once, which is a different idea about tea entirely: the pot on top holds concentrate, and everyone dilutes to taste from the tap below. The electric version kept the shape and lost the charcoal.
The model holds 37,555 polygons and 37,569 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied as a set. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits kitchen and interior visualisation, product and e-commerce imagery, cultural and hospitality scenes, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

Breast tissue changes structurally during pregnancy rather than simply in size, and understanding what happens requires a baseline. A pre pregnancy model is that baseline, and every explanation of lactation or of screening starts from it.
The model is extremely light at 1,210 polygons and 1,250 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so it runs anywhere including a browser. It carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits medical education and patient explanation, obstetric and breastfeeding material, screening and health campaigns, interactive learning and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A structural firefighting helmet is designed for a world with no floor plan. It has to survive impact from above, deflect water and heat, carry a lamp and a visor, and stay on a head that is being moved through smoke by feel rather than by sight.
The model holds 47,884 polygons and 51,011 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 16 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits emergency services visualisation, protective equipment marketing, training material, character accessories, film costume and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.
